Модель разбирает находки SAST по одной:: The model triages SAST findings one by one: urgent ones first, then by severity; duplicates go next to each other and reuse the existing verdict.
Профиль задаёт сервер модели этого проек: The profile sets the model server for this project; the "Model" list below comes from that server. Changing the profile does not touch existing verdicts: a run with the new profile's model triages only findings without a verdict; to triage everything again, check "Ask the model again".
